_comment: Permission-gate rule severities — this file is the single control surface; no severity decisions live in code. Per rule: "off" = silent, "warn" = note and proceed, "error" = block. Legacy values still parse: 0/1/2 and true/false. A key that is missing or set to garbage fails closed to "error" with a stderr warning. One-off override without editing: PGATE_<SCREAMING_SNAKE_KEY>=off|warn|error (e.g. PGATE_RERUN_GUARD=off). Safety floor: destructiveConfirm and commitMessageLint cannot be configured below "error". Rule IDs (R1, P3, ...) are the internal cross-reference used in source comments and the README rule table; keys here are the stable, human-readable names — either spelling works in `rules` (`editRegionGuard` or `AG2`); entries below use the IDs. outputCap/confirm/destructive tune numeric limits and the confirm command list. The docs object maps every rule ID to a one-line description — advisory, never parsed.

docs.AG: Edits (anchor): blocks an edit whose oldText misses (exact or fuzzy), whose anchor is non-unique, or whose anchors overlap within one call.
docs.AG2: Edits (region): the edit's target lines must themselves have been read; 'off' downgrades to path-read-this-session parity.
docs.WB: Writes (binding): overwriting an existing file binds like an edit — never-read, stat drift, or hash drift blocks with a re-read fix.
docs.R1: Reads (re-read): a re-read fully covered by certified in-context spans blocks; partial overlap passes; resets on compaction and failed edits.
docs.R1x: Reads (consume): >=50% of a read's rendered lines already certified — 'warn' notes, 'error' blocks at call time, 'off' disables.
docs.R1b: Reads (large window): whole-file or >=500-line read of a >10KB file blocks with a targeted-window fix.
docs.R1c: Reads (locate-first): >=100-line window on a never-searched path blocks with the search to run first.
docs.P1: Hygiene (native read): built-in read blocked while piread is registered; 'off' restores the built-in.
docs.P2: Hygiene (native bash): built-in bash blocked while pibash is registered; 'off' restores the built-in.
docs.P3: Hygiene (native write): built-in write blocked while piwrite is registered; 'off' restores the built-in.
docs.VC: Hygiene (view credit): printed lines of a mappable head/tail/sed -n/cat view certify read spans; any non-'off' value enables.
docs.H1: Bash (output cap): non-blocking — output capped at 40 lines / 2KB, full text spilled to $TMPDIR/pgate-spill with a pointer.
docs.H1b: Reads (output cap): non-blocking — read results over 300 lines / 8KB truncate to head, full text spilled.
docs.OS: Bash (output scrub): lossless-or-labeled compaction before the H1 cap — ANSI stripped, passing tests aggregated, failures kept verbatim.
docs.H2: Bash (destructive confirm): sudo, rm, forced git, installs, DB drops need approval; safety floor — cannot go below 'error'.
docs.R9: Git (commit lint): git commit -m checked against the commitlint pattern; safety floor — cannot go below 'error'.
docs.R10: Bash (re-run): identical re-run <=10 min after its last success with no intervening mutation blocks.
docs.RB: Bash (reblock): verbatim re-send of a just-blocked command escalates with a dedicated reason.
docs.TC1: Toolchain (pnpm pin): npm/npx/yarn in a pnpm-pinned repo blocks; use pnpm run/exec/dlx.
docs.TC2: Toolchain (node pin): node-family binary missing the exact .nvmrc/engines pin warns; prefix nvm use.
docs.SS1: Search (scope): recursive grep/rg with no path or glob scope blocks — scope it (rg PATTERN path/).
docs.SS2: Search (mid-pipe): a grep segment reached mid-pipe blocks; use single-process rg PATTERN path/.
docs.SS3: Search (find-first): a find-headed segment warns; use fd PATTERN path/.
docs.SS4: Search (replace flag): rg carrying -r/--replace (display substitution) warns; drop the flag.
docs.PB1: Search (portability): grep -P on darwin warns; use rg -P or grep -E.
docs.SE1: Hygiene (error swallow): non-blocking note when a command tails '|| true', hiding the real error.
docs.SE2: Hygiene (reader-bypass): non-blocking note when sed -n/cat reads a file — the printed lines still certify.
docs.CN: Cadence: non-blocking nudge at ~120 turns / ~150K context tokens; resets on compaction.
docs.LG1: Edits (loop guard): note at the 4th same-path edit in a turn, one-shot block at the 7th; resets per user turn.
docs.R11: Bash (failure streak): >=5 consecutive tool failures with no landed mutation block the next shell call.
docs.PH1: Phase (label): advisory only, never blocks — labels the turn's stage, one 'recovering' note per turn.
